protocol.title: A Microfluidic DNA Library Preparation Platform for Next-Generation Sequencing
protocol.platform: DMF hub with peripheral capillary-based modules (digital microfluidics + continuous-flow off-chip modules)
samples: Human genomic DNA (peripheral blood mononuclear cells)
protocol.objective: Fully integrated, automated microfluidic system for preparing Illumina sequencer-ready NGS libraries from nanogram-scale genomic DNA via tagmentation, bead-based clean-up, limited-cycle PCR, and two-stage size selection

device.hub_type: Digital microfluidic (DMF) hub with in-plane capillary-to-module interface
gap_configurations: 185 um gap (human gDNA; 1-2 uL droplet volumes)

substrate.bottom_plate: ITO-patterned glass; photolithography and etching; coated with 4 um Parylene-C + 50 nm Teflon-AF
substrate.top_plate: Unpatterned ITO glass; coated with 50 nm Teflon-AF

peripheral_modules.tagmentation: Thermal module; 750 um OD tubing recessed ~100 um in Al block trench (~850 um deep x 800 um wide); closed-loop PID TEC
peripheral_modules.limited_cycle_PCR: Thermal cycling module; OpenPCR benchtop cycler; same Al block configuration
peripheral_modules.cleanup: Magnetic bead module; 3 mm dia x 3 mm neodymium magnet (K&J Magnetics); positive pressure-driven syringe pump for near-complete supernatant removal
peripheral_modules.size_selection: Magnetic bead module; same magnet/pump configuration as clean-up; two-stage bead:DNA ratio protocol

device.manifold_frame: Custom-engineered polymer manifold with metal compression frame; pogo-pin electrical contacts; CapTite fittings (Sandia National Labs)

reagents.surfactant_additive: Pluronic F127, 0.1% w/v in TE buffer (added to all DNA and reagent solutions to prevent biofouling on Teflon-AF surfaces)

dna_sample.human_gDNA: Isolated from peripheral blood mononuclear cells (ATCC); 5 ng/uL in TE + 0.1% F127
dna_sample.ecoli_gDNA: E. coli MG1655 (ATCC); extracted with DNeasy Blood and Tissue Kit (Qiagen); quantified by Qubit (Life Technologies)
dna_sample.kpn_gDNA: K. pneumoniae BAA-2146 (KpnNDM) (ATCC); same extraction and quantitation

nextera_enzyme_mix.composition: 2 uL High Molecular Weight component + 0.5 uL enzyme mix (Nextera DNA Sample Preparation Kit, Illumina)
nextera_enzyme_mix.pluronic_additive: 0.1% w/v Pluronic F127 to prevent biofouling (validated not to affect tagmentation efficiency; Fig S1)

pcr_mixture.composition: 12.5 uL 2X PCR buffer + 0.5 uL primer cocktail + 0.5 uL PCR enzyme + 0.5 uL 50X Adapter 2 (Nextera kit)

reagents.magnetic_beads: SPRI beads - Solid Phase Reversible Immobilisation (Beckman Coulter, Danvers MA)
reagents.wash_solvent: Ethanol (HPLC-grade organic solvent; nuclease-free water used throughout)
reagents.decontamination: 10% v/v bleach then deionized water rinse between library runs

steps.name: gDNA sample dispensing and Nextera enzyme mixing
steps.mixing_method: Continuous aspiration and dispensing in and out of capillary for 30 s at room temperature
steps.notes: All droplets prepared in TE + 0.1% Pluronic F127 (w/v). Air gap of 1-2 uL separates reagent bolus from pumping water in syringe. Fluid boluses moved at 10 uL/min.

steps.name: Tagmentation
steps.operation: heat incubation in peripheral thermal module
steps.module: Tagmentation thermal module (Al block, closed-loop PID TEC)
steps.product: Adapter-tagged DNA fragments; broad distribution 150-1000 bp (Fig 4b); adapter dimers ~45 bp also generated
steps.notes: Transposase simultaneously fragments and tags gDNA. Mixture aspirated from DMF hub into module tubing at 10 uL/min.

steps.name: Magnetic bead clean-up - bead capture and supernatant removal
steps.operation: merge on DMF hub + aspirate into clean-up module + magnet immobilisation + supernatant removal
steps.magnet: Neodymium, 3 mm dia x 3 mm thick (K&J Magnetics, Jamison PA)
steps.supernatant_content: Excess enzyme, adapter dimers, small DNA fragments
steps.notes: Bead pellet aggregated on inner tube wall. Positive pressure-driven flow (syringe pump) achieves near-complete supernatant removal (Fig 3, frames 1-3). Supernatant returned to DMF hub, actuated to waste capillary.

steps.name: Ethanol wash of bead pellet (x3)
steps.wash_method: Bolus shuttled back-and-forth across immobilised bead pellet (chaotic mixing effect; removes trace contaminants and salts)
steps.notes: After each shuttle wash: ethanol returned to DMF hub, actuated to waste module, aspirated off-chip. Each wash uses a fresh ethanol droplet dispensed from capillary.

steps.name: Elution of purified tagmented DNA from bead pellet
steps.operation: dispense elution buffer + aspirate into clean-up module + remove magnet + resuspend + re-apply magnet + return eluate to DMF hub
steps.product: 2.2 uL purified adapter-tagged DNA fragments (excess enzyme and adapter dimers removed)
steps.notes: Magnet removed; bolus shuttled to resuspend bead pellet (30 s). Magnet re-applied; DNA-containing eluate droplet returned to DMF hub and actuated to PCR inlet electrode.

steps.name: PCR mixture dispensing and merging with eluate
steps.notes: Combined ~5 uL droplet aspirated into PCR thermal module: 2.8 uL enters the module inlet; remaining 2.2 uL actuated to waste on DMF hub.

steps.name: Limited-cycle PCR - adapter addition and library enrichment
steps.thermocycler: OpenPCR (Saratoga, CA) benchtop cycler; Al block closed-loop PID TEC
steps.product: Enriched library ~200-10000 bp with Illumina-specific sequencing adapters and dual indices; primer dimers ~55 bp present (Fig 4c)
steps.notes: PCR reaction mixture (2.8 uL) cycled in module. After PCR, product dispensed back onto DMF hub for size selection. 9 cycles used for bacterial gDNA (400 um gap hub).

steps.name: Size selection Stage 1 - removal of fragments <200 bp
steps.operation: merge PCR product with SPRI beads + aspirate into size-selection module + magnet immobilisation + supernatant recovery
steps.bead_to_dna_ratio: high (binds all DNA including small fragments and primer dimers)
steps.supernatant_content: Desired 200-400 bp library fragments (remain in solution at this bead:DNA ratio)
steps.notes: Supernatant -- not bead-bound fraction -- carries the size-selected library at this stage. Bead pellet (small DNA <200 bp, primer dimers) disposed.

steps.name: Size selection Stage 2 - removal of fragments >400 bp
steps.operation: merge supernatant with low-volume SPRI beads + aspirate into size-selection module + magnet immobilisation + ethanol wash + elution
steps.bead_to_dna_ratio: low (binds only large fragments >400 bp; desired 200-400 bp library bound to pellet)
steps.product: Final sequencer-ready DNA library; target size 200-400 bp (Fig 4d)
steps.notes: At Stage 2 the desired 200-400 bp library is bead-bound; large fragments (>400 bp) remain in solution and are disposed. 3 uL elution buffer used for human gDNA; 5 uL for bacterial gDNA (400 um gap hub). Library dispensed back to DMF hub for QC and sequencing.

off_chip_qc.quantitation: Kapa Library Quantification Kit (KAPA Biosystems, Woburn MA)
off_chip_qc.read_archive: NCBI Sequence Read Archive accession SAMN02152539 (E. coli); APNN00000000.1 (K. pneumoniae)

kpn_BAA2146.description: First US K. pneumoniae isolate positive for NDM-1 (New Delhi metallo-beta-lactamase); previously unsequenced

notable_findings: Small high-copy number plasmid fully assembled
At least 5 beta-lactamase genes including NDM-1

basic_blocks.label: main
basic_blocks.description: Dispense gDNA + Nextera enzyme; tagmentation; bead clean-up + 3x ethanol wash + elution; PCR mix + limited-cycle PCR; two-stage size selection; library elution; QC detect

basic_blocks.label: bsbbif_2_t
basic_blocks.action: dispose(dnaLibrary); library ready for MiSeq loading at 8 pM

basic_blocks.label: bsbbif_4_j
basic_blocks.description: dispose(librarySignal); experiment ends; library available off-chip for sequencing
